leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize state variables to track drag-and-drop interactions
Implement drag event handlers for list items
Apply drop logic to reorder list items in the DOM
Configure visual feedback during drag operations
Integrate drag-and-drop functionality into a list component
Manipulate array data to reflect reordered items
Construct a complete drag-and-drop reordering interface
lessonTitle: Build drag and drop list reordering
